subject.title: feat: enable the new exec approvals pipeline behind an opt-in setting

question: May this manual, default-off V2 execution path ship before prompt UI exists, provided current-head gateway-to-MXC proof passes, or must the complete approval UX land first?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but code review cannot decide whether exposing a fallback-only authorization path is an acceptable product and security rollout boundary.

options.title: Require MXC proof, allow experimental rollout
options.body: Keep the setting default-off, require a passing real gateway-to-MXC run and clear operator guidance, and allow prompt UI to follow separately.

options.title: Wait for complete approval UX
options.body: Hold this PR until prompt-required decisions have a supported in-product approval surface rather than fallback-only behavior.

options.title: Do not expose the parallel path
options.body: Close or redesign the rollout if maintainers do not want a second manually configured `system.run` policy path.

recommendation.title: Require MXC proof, allow experimental rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the setting default-off, require a passing real gateway-to-MXC run and clear operator guidance, and allow prompt UI to follow separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest independent history signal is prior ownership of `system.run` hardening and exec-approval security fixes.
